goal: Keep analyst playbook authoring fast while preserving fail-closed release verification.

FAST_EDIT.purpose: Immediate feedback after a local applied-playbook edit.
required_checks: pinned Ordo lint + compile through audit_generated_ordo_language.py
applied validator wiring audit when runtime validator tools are present
fail-fast parse-before-semantic validation order audit when staged runtime validators are present
FAST_EDIT.promotion: PASS permits continued editing only; it is not a readiness or release claim.

PLAYBOOK_VERIFY.purpose: Verify one applied playbook before sharing or checkpointing it.
required_checks: package-local validator fixture/E2E suite when supplied
Editor replay/Auto Answers package shape validation
PLAYBOOK_VERIFY.promotion: PASS permits a verified applied-playbook checkpoint, not factory acceptance.

FULL_FACTORY.purpose: Shared-system, language-contract, factory-tooling, checkpoint/readiness or acceptance verification.
required_checks: impact policy says FULL_REQUIRED or explicit milestone/checkpoint

selection_rules: Ordinary applied package-local edits default to FAST_EDIT during iteration without asking the user to choose a mode.
Text-only applied-playbook edits must not trigger PLAYBOOK_VERIFY or FULL_FACTORY unless the edited text is shared executable policy.
Use the latest VERIFIED checkpoint as the regression baseline and verify the dependency delta rather than replaying already-proven history.
Before handing an applied package to another chat/person or promoting a checkpoint, run PLAYBOOK_VERIFY.
Changes to shared Vibe factory, pinned Ordo/compiler/runtime foundation, shared regression infrastructure, canonical laws, or accepted-baseline governance require FULL_FACTORY.
Explicit user finalization/readiness/acceptance requires full verification appropriate to the changed scope.
Unknown or ambiguous impact fails closed to FULL_FACTORY.
FAST_EDIT or PLAYBOOK_VERIFY must never be reported as full factory regression.
Measure contour wall-clock; strong FAST_EDIT slowdown is a DX regression to investigate.

ux_target.FAST_EDIT: seconds to tens of seconds for a small playbook
ux_target.FULL_FACTORY: allowed to be slow; run at system boundaries, not every edit
ux_target.FIRST_ANALYST_VISIBLE_ALPHA: target <=10 minutes when required source inputs are available and no external human-authority decision is needed
